title: Quadratic character pair
statement: For $n\ge 0$, a pair of functions $\ell:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ and $q:\mathbb F_2^{n\times n}\to\mathbb F_2$ is a quadratic character pair if there exists $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$ such that $\ell(x)=\sum_{i=1}^n\gamma_i x_i$ for every $x$, and $q$ is the matrix character associated with the rank-one matrix $\gamma\gamma^{\mathsf T}$.
hypotheses_covered: Existence of a vector $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$ satisfying both function identities
caveat: The supplied material does not define the matrix character, so its precise evaluation rule cannot be stated from this payload alone.
